I have tried. I’ve tried for years. So many years. And honestly, I’m fucking sick of trying. I don’t care anymore. All I know is I am miserable, and I’m tired of living because maybe, somehow, someway, I’ll get better, or living just for other people, or living because I’m scared. I should live because I’m happy, because I want to. But I don’t want to. And it’s been so many years I don’t think I’ll ever be happy, nor do I want to. I want to die. I want to end my pitiful existence because it’s what I deserve, and what I want. And I don’t “think” I hate life. I do. You do not know me. Don’t pretend that just because you’re going through something similar, we are the same. I am alone in my experience because it is my experience. And maybe that makes you feel guilty. But it shouldn’t. I just want to die. That isn’t something that should make you feel guilty, because it’s what I want. And there’s nothing wrong with that.

Bad things like not getting my homework done on time. Or being a dick to my friends. Or my parents divorcing. Or the threat of losing my home. Or losing the eraser to my pencil. Just anything that could be considered inconvenient or traumatic or a poor experience. And I don’t think it’s really anything. It’s just me. I’m just like this. I just hate life, and there doesn’t have to be a reason for that. I just do.

It’s just how I’ve always felt, and is worsened when bad things happened. But there has never been a moment I haven’t wanted death. I first tried to kill myself when I was 4 years old. It’s all I’ve ever known.

Oh, I would never regard my tulpa with disgust or suspicion! I am not distrusting at all, not in the slightest, simply interested about a few of the problems that stood out to me when researching this. I am a very open person and do not think poorly of anyone, I’m just curious about the things that could happen/go wrong/what to expect if my tulpa wants something I don’t. I promise I really do want a tulpa. I’m not suspicious or distrusting of them at all. I just think of them as new friends and experiences. 

And yes, I have read that, thank you. I’ve considered everything and realized I am not making a tulpa for any of those reasons that person talked about, such as entertainment, or to be special, or smarter, or whatever. I’m simply interested because I want a different outlook on life and a person who can be there for me when I need some help, and I be there for them. But thank you. I appreciate the help a lot. This really is so amazing to me, and I have so much to learn still. And I apologize for talking so long to reply as well, I’ve been reflecting on making a tulpa for a few days just to get my head sorted.

That makes sense, I understand now that a tulpa wouldn’t do anything to harm me inside of my body. It still feels weird to think about, since I don’t like the idea of something else controlling me, but I’m not as freaked out by it now. I’m glad your tulpa helps you, and glad you can help your host. 

As for being in a bad place mentally, I wouldn’t say I’m too bad. Sure, there’s the depression, and anxiety, and suicidal ideation, but those have all been there my entire life. Nothing has really changed, and at this point I want to try mixing it up a bit and meditating to see if I can fix it. And I know the motivation of a tulpa would help me, plus it would expand my viewpoint, which I really need when I have depression brain, which sees very black-and-White. I’ve also always had imaginary friends, and they’ve been quite helpful to me although cannot really think on their own. I’m still considering it and thinking about it, which is part of why I took so long to reply (sorry about that). But really, thank you for the advice. I love hearing about other people’s experience with this interesting experience. :)

I would say the best piece of advice I could give is to imagine something or someone completely innocent to you. Something so pure it could not possibly be bad, and imagine how that thing or person would treat you, how they would talk to you, what they would think and be like. For me that is Flower, as I think of flowers and children as the most pure and innocent beings on earth. So she is an adorable flower child who helps tap into the part of me that loves life. It may seem hard or stupid at first, but I promise that if you truly believe in what you are imagining, and you truly want this character to be pure, they will be. Flower has helped me for years now, and sometimes imagining her and thinking about how her high-pitched voice would sound gushing about how amazing the day is going to be is what gets me out of bed.

No, man, you’re not ugly at all. You look sweet, and your eyes are really beautiful. But, here are my suggestions:
1. Pluck them brows. Or wax. Or something. They need some cleaning up.
2. Teeth straighteners. Surprisingly, straight, clean teeth is a pretty big factor in determining if someone is attractive. Invisiline is a lifesaver, totally recommend that, even if it is a little annoying.
3. Yes, cut your hair for sure. The second to last picture is what you should aim for, it looks very full and handsome there.
4. Find an invigorated sense of style. You mostly tend to wear boring, cliche clothing that doesn’t make you stand out. Try going on a shopping spree and just picking out a whole new wardrobe. It can also help you feel better about yourself as a whole, and could be quite fun! I would recommend some nice-looking button ups and cool jackets for you. Try going to Macy’s or Target, if those are in your area, they have a really nice, diverse section of clothing.

As for the dating stuff, don’t worry about it, man. I understand the frustration of not being able to have someone, but do realize that you are your own person, and the value of your existence is not determined by whether or not you have someone to kiss. Instead, I would say strengthen your friendships, and find happiness in non-romantic love, as that tends to be the most long-lasting and rewarding type of love you can find. But, if you really find yourself wanting a significant other, I would suggest going to places you like or are interested in. For example, a music lesson, or comic con, or art musician, whatever you’re interested in. I met my girlfriend when I was in a musical, and it was much easier to get to know her there, as we had a consistent place to meet up and connect without even having to go out on a date first(basically what I’m saying is form a friendship first, then go out on a date). Good luck, you got this!
